g.text: 8 GPCs · 96 SMs · 12 HBM3 memory partitions behind one crossbar; copies (xN) stand for identical instances
work arrives from the GigaThread Engine; loads, stores and finished pixels
leave through the crossbar to the L2 slices and ROPs in the memory partitions
Inside one SM (2 per TPC, 96 in all)
L1 data cache / shared memory 256 KB
128 KB L1 instruction cache · 4 texture units
